articleTitle: How to Stop Regretting Every Choice You've Made
imageHeadline: Stuck replaying old decisions? Here's how to move forward.
imageSubtext: Evidence-based strategies to break the regret loop and trust yourself again.
pinTitle: How to Stop Regretting Every Choice You've Made | Break the Cycle of Chronic Regret
pinDescription: Chronic regret about past decisions—school, jobs, relationships—can keep you stuck in a painful loop. Learn why your brain gets trapped in this pattern and practical, evidence-based strategies to build confidence in your choices going forward.
